trigger_condition: memory_list receives an invalid memory type string
guard_snippet: type: Annotated[str | None, Field(pattern=r'^(semantic|episodic|procedural|working)$', description='Memory type: semantic, episodic, procedural, or working.')] = None

trigger_condition: chat SSE error event contains detail as dict
guard_snippet: detail = payload.get('detail'); message = (detail.get('message') if isinstance(detail, dict) else detail) or payload.get('message') or 'agent error'
potential_consequence: message becomes stringified dict, error unreadable

trigger_condition: backend returns empty or invalid run response
guard_snippet: if not isinstance(run, dict) or run.get('id') is None: raise ToolError(f'Backend did not return a valid run for automation {automation_id}')

trigger_condition: empty city or district string is provided
guard_snippet: city: Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, description='City name or slug...')]; district: Annotated[str | None, Field(min_length=1, description='Optional district name or slug.')] = None
potential_consequence: scraper runs with empty location and fails or returns wrong data

trigger_condition: empty city or district string is provided
guard_snippet: city: Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, description='City name or slug...')] = 'ho-chi-minh'; district: Annotated[str | None, Field(min_length=1, description='Optional district name or slug.')] = None
potential_consequence: default city is overridden or scraper fails

trigger_condition: min_price or min_area exceeds the corresponding max
guard_snippet: if (min_price is not None and max_price is not None and min_price > max_price) or (min_area is not None and max_area is not None and min_area > max_area): raise ValueError('min value cannot exceed max value')
potential_consequence: muaban backend accepts invalid range, returns wrong results

trigger_condition: size, quality, style, or model string is too long
guard_snippet: size: Annotated[str | None, Field(max_length=50, description=...)]; quality: Annotated[str | None, Field(max_length=50, description=...)]; style: Annotated[str | None, Field(max_length=50, description=...)]; model: Annotated[str | None, Field(max_length=200, description=...)]
potential_consequence: backend rejects with 422 for oversized fields
tool hangs up to 600s before failing

trigger_condition: SSE terminator line contains only whitespace
guard_snippet: if line == '' or line.strip() == '': if buffer: yield SseEvent(data='\n'.join(buffer)); buffer.clear(); continue
potential_consequence: buffer not flushed, events concatenated across frames
